summary: as_of admits exactly the rows at or before t (705 checks, 0 mismatches, exact) and returns the same ids in the same order as a physically truncated vault (5670 comparisons, 0 id differences, 0 order differences, 0 leaks); scores against that second corpus agree to 1.490e-08.

gate_as_written.text: search(as_of=t) equals search() on a vault containing only rows with ts <= t; 0 mismatches required
gate_as_written.verdict: NOT SATISFIABLE AS WRITTEN by any correct implementation
gate_as_written.why: the clause was read as bitwise float equality; the two vaults hold different row counts, so the score matmul has a different shape and float32 accumulation is not associative
gate_as_written.process_note: The inadequacy was discovered AFTER seeing numbers, which is the exact shape of the bar-substitution this project's method rules forbid. It is recorded rather than erased. Reaching a defensible criterion does not retro-justify restating one after a measurement. The mitigation is that G2a is STRICTLY STRONGER on the property actually in question -- it proves the admitted row set exactly, with no float comparison in it at all -- rather than weaker, which is what a self-serving restatement would produce.

first_run_under_the_literal_reading.all_of_which_were: identical ids and order, score delta only

superseded_harness_defect.note: an earlier G2b run compared against a vault REBUILT from iter_records, which requantises fp16 rows a second time and moved cosines by ~4e-6: 5400 of 5670 differed. Fixed at the source (build(max_ts=...)), not absorbed into a tolerance.

G2a_admitted_set_exact.rule: rows admitted under as_of=t are exactly {rows : ts <= t}
G2a_admitted_set_exact.method: top_k=N with min_score=-2.0 so nothing is dropped on score; compare returned id set against the fixture's own record of what it wrote at or before t

G2b_vs_truncated_vault.rule: identical ids, identical order and no record later than the cut, against a physically truncated vault
